versions.changelog:
Initial release of Runbook Generator.

- Scans project files (Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, systemd units, Makefiles, package.json, config files) to extract operational details.
- Generates structured operational runbooks in Markdown or JSON with build, deploy, start/stop/restart, rollback, troubleshooting, and monitoring procedures.
- CLI script with flexible output formats and easy integration.
- Designed for creation of deployment guides, SRE runbooks, and operational documentation.
